description: Defines classes and structures for managing UE resources in a DU RAN environment, including resource configuration, update responses, and resource manager creation.

classes.name: du_ue_resource_update_response
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a UE resource allocation request, indicating success or failure.

classes.name: ue_ran_resource_configurator
classes.description: Manages UE resource configuration, updates, and retrieval of UE resources and capabilities.

classes.name: du_ran_resource_manager
classes.description: Creates new UE resource configuration objects using a resource pool.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Initiates update of UE resources based on a context update request.

methods.name: resource_alloc_failed
methods.description: Checks if resource allocation failed due to lack of resources.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles confirmation that UE resource configuration is complete.

methods.name: get_error
methods.description: Returns error message if configuration procedure failed.

methods.name: create_ue_resource_configurator
methods.description: Creates a new UE resource configurator object.
